description: What the main window is allowed to ask of the system. Everything CryptoVault does to a vault goes through this crate's own commands, which are not plugin calls and are not listed here. What is listed is the one capability the interface borrows from the system: opening a folder picker, so that choosing where a vault lives is a choice made in the operating system's own dialogue rather than typed into a text field. `dialog:allow-open` is granted alone — the save, message and confirmation dialogues are not used and stay unavailable, so a compromised page cannot put a system-looking prompt in front of the user.
